reason: I already pay a setter and I know what he does. This has zero customer results and a card-up-front trial that bills on day 4 with no refunds, so I'd be betting $147 on a tool nobody can show me working. I've watched enough SMMA tool pitches at night to know how that usually ends.
objection: Three days is not enough time to know if AI-written DMs book calls, because replies and booked calls take longer than that to show up. After day 4 it bills and payments are final, and there are no published results to go on. That looks like a trap to me. Is my Instagram account going to get flagged too?
would_change_my_mind: A trial of 7 days or more, or a refund window after the first charge. Add a few real customers with real booked-call numbers, ideally an agency or coach like me.
